integrity: Full first-level multiplication and every candidate second-level endomorphism are reconstructed and tested by a Python 3 standard-library checker. Semigroup endomorphisms need not preserve identity; both cases are counted. Independent validation not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete exact 43-map and rank census only for the semigroup endomorphism tower of S_3, not the higher-degree n>=7 theory or other groups. Historical priority against unindexed specialist computations is uncertain.
title: Exact second endomorphism tower census of the smallest nonabelian symmetric group
